pages.title: Supercritical Solvent
pages.text: A fluid past its critical point, neither liquid nor gas. It diffuses like a gas and dissolves like a liquid, getting into every pore. It is warm and almost invisible. Industry uses supercritical water and carbon dioxide to dissolve what nothing else will.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Heating charcoal and water past their critical point in the Chemical Reactor, the water became supercritical, dissolving things it never could before.
